passives.name: Oath of Meteos
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Inflicts Unhealable on all enemies. This effect cannot be removed. Inflicts Unbuffable on the enemy with the highest Attack for [Buff_T_4076002_18_3] turn(s) at the start of the turn. When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, recovers [Buff_V_4076002_17_2] Weakness Gauge. Increases damage dealt proportional to the number of debuffs on the caster, but reduces damage dealt when the target has a Barrier. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Water enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], while increasing damage dealt to them and reducing damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them.
